outcomes.question: How long after I've paid for something can I still claim it back?
outcomes.answer:
Claims approved by the 10th of the month are reimbursed with your salary on the 25th. Claims approved after the 10th are paid the following month. [1]

Without an authorisation code the patient pays in full and claims the cost back from their insurer. [2]

outcomes.question: Is there a day when the whole team is expected in the office?
outcomes.answer:
Tell the People Team about a pregnancy or adoption match at least 15 weeks before the expected date so that cover can be planned. [1]

Eligible full-time employees may work from home for up to two days a week. The other three days are spent at the Eastmere support office or at a clinic. Each team chooses one anchor day a week when everyone is in the office together; your manager will tell you which day that is. New starters work on site every day for their first four weeks. [2]

outcomes.question: Can my manager cancel my hybrid working arrangement?
outcomes.answer: Hybrid working is not a contractual right. Your manager may ask you to attend on a home day with 48 hours' notice when the work requires it, and an arrangement can be ended with four weeks' notice if it is not working for the team. [1]

outcomes.question: How long before my laptop locks itself if I walk away?
outcomes.answer: Lock your screen whenever you leave your desk. At the end of the day, lock away paper that contains confidential or patient-identifiable information. Confidential paper waste goes in the locked shredding bins, never in ordinary recycling. [1]

outcomes.question: Where does everyone gather when the fire alarm goes off?
outcomes.answer:
When the alarm sounds, stop what you are doing. Take the visitor sign-in tablet, direct everyone in the waiting area to the nearest exit and go to the assembly point in the car park. [1]

Nobody goes back inside until the fire service says it is safe. [2]
